text: Astronomy, the study of celestial objects and phenomena, has led us to numerous fascinating discoveries. Among the many wonders of the universe, craters stand out as a striking feature. These impact craters, formed by asteroids or comets colliding with planets, offer a glimpse into the violent history of our solar system. The Marss crater, on the Moon, is a prime example, with its vast, bowl-shaped structure revealing insights into the Moon's formation and evolution. Beyond craters, astronomers continue to unravel the mysteries of orbiting bodies, such as the elliptical path of planets around the Sun, and the complex dance of asteroids and comets in the Kuiper Belt.
